slides.headline: A hand that makes one full turn
slides.body: A GMT watch adds a hand that makes one full turn every 24 hours.

slides.headline: Read it against a 24-hour scale
slides.body: The bezel scale shows the second city time, day or night. Turning the bezel tracks a third zone.

slides.label: Current US prices
slides.headline: Two watches with a GMT hand
slides.body: Both use the same idea: a second hand on a 24-hour scale.
